description: Codex, design review of the Python versions (round 2): an implicit concatenation of a string and an f-string is a JoinedStr, not a str constant, so not a docstring, and its interpolation runs. `"Parses " f"{1 / 0}"` raises before `self.skipTest("pending")`: the skip is not the first statement of the test (F2), a WARN, never a FAIL.
